Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM

DECLARE
 cnt NUMBER ;
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 IF :ctrl_block_1.contract_type= 'IN' AND 
 :ctrl_block_1.contract_id = 'INTERNAL' 
 THEN
 BEGIN 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 :SYSTEM.SUPPRESS_WORKING:= 'TRUE';
 GO_BLOCK('contacts');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 GO_BLOCK('contracts');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 :SYSTEM.SUPPRESS_WORKING:= 'FALSE';
 END;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 IF :ctrl_block_1.contract_id IS NULL
 THEN
 GO_BLOCK('contacts');
 CLEAR_BLOCK(NO_VALIDATE);
 GO_BLOCK('contracts');
 CLEAR_BLOCK(NO_VALIDATE);
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT company 
 INTO :ctrl_block_1.company
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_type = :ctrl_block_1.contract_type AND 
 chapter_id = :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id AND 
 contract_id = :ctrl_block_1.contract_id
 ;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 :SYSTEM.SUPPRESS_WORKING := 'TRUE';

 GO_BLOCK('contacts');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 GO_BLOCK('contracts');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;

 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 :SYSTEM.SUPPRESS_WORKING := 'FALSE';
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) 
 INTO cnt
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_type = :ctrl_block_1.contract_type AND 
 chapter_id = :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id AND 
 --NVL(term_date,SYSDATE)>=DECODE(:ctrl_block_1.show_term,'N',SYSDATE,NVL(term_date,SYSDATE) ) AND --- SCR 18938
 NVL(term_date,v_local_date)>=DECODE(:ctrl_block_1.show_term,'N',v_local_date,NVL(term_date,v_local_date) ) AND 
 UPPER(company) LIKE '%'||UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(:ctrl_block_1.contract_id)))||'%'
 ;
 IF cnt = 0 
 THEN
 show_error ('5150');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF cnt = 1 
 THEN
 SELECT contract_id
 , company
 INTO :ctrl_block_1.contract_id
 , :ctrl_block_1.company
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_type = :ctrl_block_1.contract_type AND 
 chapter_id = :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id AND 
 --NVL(term_date,SYSDATE)>=DECODE(:ctrl_block_1.show_term,'N',SYSDATE,NVL(term_date,SYSDATE) ) AND --- SCR 18938
 NVL(term_date,v_local_date)>=DECODE(:ctrl_block_1.show_term,'N',v_local_date,NVL(term_date,v_local_date) ) AND 
 UPPER(company) LIKE '%'||UPPER(rtrim(ltrim(:ctrl_block_1.contract_id)))||'%'
 ;
 ELSE
 LIST_VALUES ;
 END IF ;
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF ;
 END ;
 END IF;
 END;
END;

Item.Name: EFF_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter the date from which this contract is effectivein DD-MON-YYYY format.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_exist_date DATE;
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 BEGIN

 IF --TRUNC(:contracts.eff_date) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND --- SCR 18938
 TRUNC(:contracts.eff_date) < TRUNC(v_local_date) AND 
 :system.record_status NOT IN ('QUERY','CHANGED')
 THEN
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 END if;

 IF :SYSTEM.RECORD_STATUS IN ('QUERY','CHANGED')
 THEN
 SELECT eff_date 
 INTO v_exist_date 
 FROM contracts 
 WHERE contract_id =:ctrl_block_1.contract_id
 ;
 IF --v_exist_date < TRUNC(SYSDATE) -- SCR 18938
 v_exist_date < TRUNC(v_local_date)
 THEN
 IF v_exist_date = :contracts.eff_date 
 THEN 
 NULL;
 ELSE
 show_error('9315');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF --v_exist_date >= trunc(SYSDATE) --- SCR 18938
 v_exist_date >= TRUNC(v_local_date) 
 THEN
 IF --:contracts.eff_date >= trunc(SYSDATE) -- SCR 18938
 :contracts.eff_date >= TRUNC(v_local_date) 
 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 show_error('9316');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_ADDRESS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_address 
IS
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;
 IF :contracts.address_id IS NULL
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT address_seq.nextval
 INTO :contracts.address_id
 FROM dual;
 :CONTRACTS.ADDRESS_UPDATE_FLAG := 'N' ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 ELSE
 :contracts.address_update_flag := 'Y' ;
 --:contracts.last_modified_date := SYSDATE;
 :contracts.last_modified_date := v_local_date;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GENERATE_CONTRACT_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure generate_contract_id is
 last_contract_id VARCHAR2(9) := NULL;
begin
begin
 select max(contract_id)
 into last_contract_id
 from contracts
 where contract_id like :contracts.chapter_id ||
 :contracts.contract_type || '%';
exception
 when others then handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
--
if last_contract_id is null
then
 :ctrl_block_1.contract_id := :contracts.chapter_id ||
 :contracts.contract_type || '0001';
else
 :ctrl_block_1.contract_id :=
 substr(last_contract_id,1,5) ||
 lpad(to_char(to_number(substr(last_contract_id,6,4))+1),4,'0');
end if;
--
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-EXIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_block = 'CTRL_BLOCK_1'
then
 exit_form(no_validate);
else
 go_block('CONTRACTS');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('CONTACTS');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 --go_block('CONTRACT_TESTS');
 --clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('CTRL_BLOCK_1');
 :ctrl_block_1.contract_id := NULL;
 :ctrl_block_1.address_id := NULL;
 :ctrl_block_1.company := NULL;
end if;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-FORM-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lIFetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 ------------------------------------------------------
 -- Code added for the LAF project integration --
 ------------------------------------------------------
 DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP(2/10);
 IF PKG_LOOK_AND_FEEL.OPEN_CSS(:PARAMETER.PM$CSS_FILENAME) 
 THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.PM$GUI IS NOT NULL 
 THEN
 -- read the GLOBAL GUI properties --
 PKG_LOOK_AND_FEEL.SET_GUI_PROPERTIES(:PARAMETER.PM$GUI, 'LAF_BLOCK.LAF_BEAN846' ) ;
 END IF ;
 -- paint the canevases --
 IF :PARAMETER.PM$CANVAS IS NOT NULL 
 THEN 
 PKG_LOOK_AND_FEEL.PAINT_CANEVAS(:PARAMETER.PM$CANVAS, 'LAF_BLOCK.LAF_BEAN846' ) ;
 END IF ;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------------------------
 -- END code added for the LAF project integration --
 ------------------------------------------------------
 INITFORM;
 --
 DEFAULT_VALUE ('TS','GLOBAL.contract_type');
 IF :GLOBAL.contract_type IS NULL 
 THEN
 MESSAGE ('Err: Contract type not selected. Contact Systems');
 PAUSE;
 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);
 END IF;
 --
 DEFAULT_VALUE ('NULL','GLOBAL.chapter_id');
 IF :GLOBAL.chapter_id = 'NULL' 
 THEN
 MESSAGE ('Err: Chapter ID not selected. Contact Systems');
 PAUSE;
 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);
 END IF;
 --
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' 
 INTO :GLOBAL.x
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'CONTR' AND 
 code = :GLOBAL.contract_type AND 
 --SYSDATE between eff_date AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE+365); --- SCR 18938
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+365)
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 MESSAGE ('Err: Invalid contract type. Contact Systems');
 PAUSE;
 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 handle_error;
 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);
 END;
 --
 :ctrl_block_1.contract_type := :GLOBAL.contract_type;
 :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
END;
